map.中医病历书写要点: Key Points for Writing TCM Medical Records
map.患者就诊的主要痛苦及持续时间，简明扼要，一般不超过20字。格式为\"主要症状+持: The patient's main suffering and its duration, concise and usually within 20 characters. Format: main symptoms + duration.
map.围绕主诉详细记录疾病发生、发展、变化及诊治经过。包括发病原因、初始症状、病情演变: Record in detail around the chief complaint how the disease arose, developed, changed, and was treated, including cause, initial symptoms, course, prior treatment and its effects.
map.重点记录神色形态和舌象。舌象包括舌质（淡红/淡白/红/绛/紫等）、舌形（胖大/瘦: Focus on spirit, complexion, body form and tongue findings. Tongue findings include the tongue body (pale red / pale white / red / crimson / purple, etc.), tongue shape (swollen / thin / teeth marks / fissures, etc.), coating (thin white / thick white / yellow greasy / thin or absent, etc.), and sublingual veins.
map.听声音（语声、呼吸、咳嗽）和嗅气味（口气、体气、排泄物气味）。: Listen to the voice (speech, breathing, cough) and smell odors (breath, body, discharges).
map.按\"十问歌\"顺序询问：一问寒热二问汗，三问头身四问便，五问饮食六问胸，七聋八: Ask in the order of the Ten Questions: first cold and heat, second perspiration; third head and body, fourth stool and urine; fifth diet, sixth chest; seventh hearing and thirst must be judged; eighth and ninth old illnesses, tenth causes; also weigh medication changes. For women always ask about menstruation, noting whether it is early, late, closed or flooding.
map.脉诊（寸关尺、浮中沉）和按诊（按肌肤、按手足、按脘腹、按俞穴）。: Pulse diagnosis (cun, guan, chi; floating, middle, deep) and palpation (skin, extremities, epigastrium and abdomen, back-shu points).
map.综合四诊资料，运用八纲辨证、脏腑辨证等方法，分析病位、病性、病机。: Synthesize the four diagnostic findings and apply eight-principle, zang-fu and other methods to analyze the location, nature, and mechanism of disease.
map.根据辨证结果确立治疗大法，如\"益气健脾\"\"活血化瘀\"\"平肝息风\"等。: Establish the governing treatment principle from the pattern, such as tonifying qi and strengthening the spleen, activating blood and resolving stasis, or calming the liver and extinguishing wind.
map.写明方名及药物组成，标注各药剂量，说明加减变化。: Name the formula and list the herb composition with doses for each herb, and note any modifications.
map.本工具生成标准化中医病历模板供学习参考，临床病历书写须遵循医疗机构规范。所有数据: This tool generates standardized TCM record templates for study and reference; clinical records must follow the standards of the medical institution. All data is processed locally in your browser and is never uploaded to any server.
